notes.title: Build a Bot Demo Release!
notes.notes:
The Demo is now live!
We at DESKRAGE are happy to finally get out a free demo of Build a Bot into your hands! It's intended as a sneak preview of what we are working on and we may throw an update or two when we have something interesting to show.



So...
What is in the Demo?
Most of the second level of the game including one of the bosses from the game

8 Gun options to mix and match

A good pile of chips to make your own unique builds

5 enemy types to test you mettle against

3 room types: Extermination, Survive and Capture the Point



Keep up with us on our socials!
